faqs.a:
For the purposes of this article the term "requesting party" means any person, partnership,
               joint venture, association, corporation, person in a representative capacity or other
               legal entity or legal representative, who shall request installation of a street light.
(Code 1960, § 21-16; Code 1981, § 30-118)
